meaning: reports/release.json release_ready and fabrication_ready only say the route passed Synth's router and DRC gates. They are not review sign-off. This file stays false until every gate below is true.

erc_dispositioned.evidence: Every ERC finding is dispositioned below by the author. passed stays false until a human reviewer confirms the dispositions.

findings.disposition: Expected. VIO is fed by the J_VIO jumper from +3V3 or VBUS, and jumper pins are passive, so no power output drives the rail and there is no PWR_FLAG. With no jumper fitted VIO is unpowered by design. Open: confirm with a reviewer whether to add a PWR_FLAG.
Not a design fault. The exported schematic uses the embedded symbols and the KiCad run had no 'power' library configured.
Not a design fault. The footprints are embedded in the PCB and the KiCad run had no global footprint libraries such as Connector_USB.
Benign. The MODEM_IDLE bus is drawn as several overlapping segments of the same net, so its label touches more than one wire. All of them are MODEM_IDLE.

Fixed. The MODEM_IDLE name label sat where the RXD1_MCU flag stub crosses the MODEM_IDLE bus, so KiCad joined the two nets. The exporter now moves a name label off other nets' wires (one label moved from y 49.53 to 48.26 mm), and the ERC finding is gone. The routed PCB already had them as separate nets.

usb_si_pi_review.evidence: no independent review; USB pair is not coupled, skew unmeasured, layer changes lack nearby ground vias

rs485_termination_and_protection.evidence: R_TERM is permanently connected and there is no A/B surge network; no expert-approved operating envelope

fabrication_review.evidence: via-in-pad at U1.25 needs fill and cap; JLCPCB has not confirmed

component_and_manufacturer_review.evidence: reviewer_state is false for every part in reports/release.json

reproducible_from_clean_checkout.evidence: A clean export on 2026-10-26 (synth commit 22a9d23, FreeRouting 2.4.1, KiCad 10.0.5, empty XDG_DATA_HOME) did not reproduce the committed board: 1 DRC clearance error (VBUS via 0.178 mm from D1 pad 2, rule 0.2 mm), 41 warnings, routing state validation_failed. FreeRouting output is not bit-for-bit repeatable, so the committed PCB is a recorded result, not a regenerable one.
